items.title: Jack DeJohnette interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 7, 2025
items.q: Well my mother, my mother supported me.

ctx.x: Well was this playing gigs at a young age, and you had supportive parents, is that correct?
Well my mother, my mother supported me. My father did but they were separated.
Did you get a sense that you could make a living at this, and when did this occur for you? Was it gradual or did you just decide obviously this is what I’m going to do for my career?
